list.name: logquery
list.label: LogsQL
list.description: Free-form LogsQL filter appended to the source filter

options.content:
| Goal | LogsQL |
|------|--------|
| Logs for a PR | `pr_number:3260` |
| Specific build | `build_id:2032076068386508800` |
| Failed events | `source:event AND level:Error` |
| Pod scheduling issues | `source:pod AND Pending` |
| Build failures | `source:openshift_build AND Failed` |
| Keyword search | `timeout` or `OOMKilled` |
| Combine filters | `pr_number:3260 AND source:event AND level:Error` |
| Regex match | `_msg:~"duration.*[0-9]{4}"` |

Use the **Source** dropdown for quick filtering, and **LogsQL** box for additional filters. For complex multi-line queries, use [Explore](../explore) with the VictoriaLogs datasource.

[LogsQL reference docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/)
